title: M3-3 owner audit Phase B: FFA 2026 data coverage, ownership reconstruction, league-constrained D/ST evaluation
objective: Owner Phase B requirements (AUDIT_REMEDIATION_AND_COMPLETION_REQUIREMENTS_PHASE-B.md): record that 2026 is FFA's inaugural season (owner decision, source docs, knowledge base, research audit); inventory and verify the ESPN data capabilities Arbit already reaches through its existing guarded integration, with a 2026 season and scoring-period coverage matrix, eligibility and temporal-integrity classes; validate lineups, rosters, player statistics and transactions; reconstruct 2026 ownership and availability from the draft and executed transactions, verified against every captured period roster and archived snapshots; split C05L into C05L-HIST (NOT_APPLICABLE), C05L-2026-EXP (run the exploratory league-constrained D/ST start/sit and streaming evaluation of B00 vs B06 on weeks 1-11) and C05L-2026-PRO (continue the prospective capture with decision-time availability); document limitations and downstream ESPN capabilities. Read-only: no provider projections, migrations, league changes, transactions or weights.

review.summary: Phase B (owner audit): read the requirements in full and inspected the ESPN audit docs, endpoint coverage, arbit_data.espn (client, reader with HISTORICAL_AVAILABILITY_UNSUPPORTED, scoring_audit), league_history (reconciled lineup captures, transaction store), league_store/snapshots, rule_version and the worker's history lanes. Database: lineups captured and reconciled 8/8 for periods 1-11; transactions read for periods 1-12 (536 records, unique ids, 0 revised after first observation, no completed trades: 2 canceled proposals, 7 declines; waivers 52 executed, 14 failed, 7 canceled); 128 draft picks; 56 matchups (44 with results); 1,520 snapshots from 2026-10-31 with an 11-day gap (2026-11-11 to 11-21, the database outage). Rules: 24-hour waivers, INDIVIDUAL_GAME locks, D/ST limit 3; in-season trades allowed (deadline 2026-12-02, 3 vetoes; the isTradingEnabled=false flag is under draftSettings). Replaying the draft and executed adds and drops reproduces every captured period roster exactly; draft transaction items carry the team on the transaction, not the item.

plan.summary: 1) OWN-076 (inaugural season) in the decision register, source register, knowledge base and audit. 2) arbit_model.ffa_history: ownership replay from the draft and executed moves, verification against captured period rosters and snapshots, availability classes with the waiver hold. 3) scripts/model/ffa_2026_inventory.py: capabilities, coverage matrix, lineup and transaction validation, ownership replay with daily snapshot checks, D/ST state at each preweek cutoff, optional live re-verification through the existing guarded client (scoring audit, transaction re-reads; nothing stored). 4) config/dvp/league-2026-exploratory.json declared and pushed first; arbit_model.dvp.league and scripts/model/dvp_league_2026.py run C05L-2026-EXP (start, stream, stream with waivers; managers; matchup effects). 5) Prospective harness captures D/ST availability at decision time and reports league results per decision kind (C05L-2026-PRO). 6) Plan audit: C05L split (HIST not applicable, 2026-EXP done, 2026-PRO open), Phase B items, new kind; receipt regenerated. 7) Documents and records.
